data.title: 德尔塔 · 林间凯旋的扑怀撒娇
data.description: 原始林地树影斑驳，刚击败魔物的德尔塔单膝跪地，金色眼眸闪烁兴奋光彩，黑犬耳与尾巴剧烈晃动，猛地扑向眼前的暗影寻求摸头奖赏。
data.location: dense primeval forest clearing with sunbeams cutting through giant trees
data.action: leaping forward onto Shadow with eager outstretched arms, wagging fluffy tail, cute fangs showing in a wide beaming grin
data.lighting: dappled forest canopy sunlight illuminating wild black hair and amber eyes
data.mood: exuberant feral affection, pure canine loyalty, innocent loving playfulness
data.promptProse: In a sunlit forest, wolf-girl Delta in black suit pounces forward joyfully with wagging tail and sparkling yellow eyes.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling in the dappled forest sunlight with a wagging tail, she looks up eagerly for affectionate headpats.
